card.name: Space before the next number in lists
card.fires_on: The gap or separator right before the next figure in a run of counts, percentages or table cells, often after 'and' or a cell value. It is strongest in outcome counts and trial result tables.

modes.label: Outcome counts in a sentence
modes.description: The space after 'and' before the last count in a list of patient outcomes.

modes.label: Table cells
modes.description: The space or separator between numeric cells in a results table.
